name: cg_coin_ohlc
description:
Open/high/low/close candles for one coin in USD over the last N days, from CoinGecko (coins/{id}/ohlc).
Returns {ohlc: [[timestamp_ms, open, high, low, close], ...]}; CoinGecko sets the candle width from the span and accepts days of 1, 7, 14, 30, 90, 180, 365 or max.
Inputs (* required): id* (string, CoinGecko coin id such as bitcoin or ethereum, not the ticker symbol; ids come from cg_search or cg_coin_list), days (integer; default 30). The quote currency is fixed to usd.
For volume and market cap series use cg_coin_market_chart.
Example: {"id": "bitcoin", "days": 7}

id.description: CoinGecko coin id (e.g. bitcoin, ethereum), not the ticker symbol

days.description: Number of days; CoinGecko accepts 1, 7, 14, 30, 90, 180 or 365
